Sectoare de activitate: Servicii de informații, Servicii IT și consultanță IT și Telecomunicații
Who We Are
 VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.
As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.
We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture
 About This Role
 We are seeking a Senior Software Developer to join our Fintech & Product Enablement team in Bucharest.
In this role, you will develop products, services, features and software modules supporting complex solutions that combine databases, business logic, user interfaces and integrations with other systems. You will contribute across the software development lifecycle, from impact assessment and estimation through design, development, testing, delivery and Level 3 application support.
You will collaborate with an international, distributed team delivering solutions for enterprise customers worldwide. The role requires at least five years of software development experience , strong object-oriented programming capabilities and experience across technologies including Java Enterprise, JavaScript, TypeScript, React, SQL, web technologies and web services.
 What You’ll Do
Develop well-structured code in line with company standards and software development best practices 
Document system changes, enhancements and technical developments 
Collaborate effectively within an internationally distributed team while contributing to multiple projects simultaneously 
Support the set-up and coordination of project and small software development teams 
Provide input into impact assessments to identify dependencies and potential effects on other systems 
Coordinate code development and delivery based on requirements, considering all relevant aspects of the product development lifecycle 
Provide accurate time and effort estimates for upcoming features based on technical and functional specifications 
Provide Level 3 support for developed applications and contribute to resolving complex technical issues 
Produce technical deliverables including impact assessments, ROM estimates, low-level designs, functional and non-functional specifications, unit test plans and results 
Provide support for end users of delivered applications 
 Who You Are
You have a minimum of five years of software development experience, including object-oriented programming 
You have advanced knowledge of software lifecycle management and associated development best practices 
You have experience with relevant technologies including Java Enterprise, JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Angular, SQL, web technologies and web services 
You have experience with relational database design and optimisation, including data normalisation 
You have experience writing PL/SQL queries 
Knowledge of data warehouse concepts is an advantage 
You are comfortable working with source control and versioning technologies such as Git, GitLab, GitHub and SVN 
You have good knowledge of Linux, including administration, maintenance and scripting 
You have good knowledge of Agile methodologies 
You have experience developing software for internet, mobile and/or communications technologies 
You can contribute to an innovative and collaborative development environment 
You have effective interpersonal, presentation and communication skills and can adapt your approach to different audiences and desired outcomes 
You can coordinate small software development teams while remaining actively involved in software delivery 
You have English language proficiency at B2 level or above 
Knowledge of another foreign language is an advantage 
A university degree is preferred 
 Not a perfect fit?
 Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.
 What's In It For You
Hybrid way of working
Medical and dental services
Life and hospitalization insurance
Dedicated employee phone subscription
Take control of your benefits and choose any of the below options: MEAL TICKETS/ PRIVATE PENSION/ VACATION VOUCHERS/ CULTURAL VOUCHERS within the budget 
Special discounts for gyms and retailers
Annual Company Bonus
Loyalty Programme
Ongoing Education – we continuously invest in you to ensure you have everything needed to excel on the job and enhance your skills
You get to work with tried and trusted web-technology
Getting in on the ground floor of a technology changing company
We let you write your own story by planning vacations: go for a trip, experience new things, have fun and enjoy your 23 days off 
Special Paternal Program - 4 months of paid paternity leave
 What Skills You Will Learn
 Through this role, you will have opportunities to further develop:
End-to-end software lifecycle management and engineering best practices 
Advanced application development across backend, frontend and database technologies 
Relational database optimisation and PL/SQL capabilities 
Technical impact assessment and dependency analysis across interconnected systems 
Software estimation, including ROM and detailed time-and-effort estimation 
Low-level solution design covering functional and non-functional requirements 
Unit testing and software quality practices 
Advanced Linux and software version-control practices 
Level 3 troubleshooting and application support 
Technical coordination and collaboration across internationally distributed development teams 
 VOIS Equal Opportunity Employer Commitment
 Vodafone recognises and celebrates the value of diversity in building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities it serves. No form of discrimination is tolerated. This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio-economic background.
 Join Us
 At Vodafone, we’re working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this.
We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together.
With us, you can truly be yourself and belong, share inspiration, embrace new opportunities, thrive, and make a real difference.
